rules: Upload results from a dedicated staging directory, never a workspace or cache parent.
Results contain tables, manifests, and logs only; no datasets, checkpoints, graph exports, build trees, or partition stores.
Keep one artifact version unless a paper explicitly cites an older immutable version.
Fail run preflight when unallowlisted artifacts or excess versions remain in the primary teamspace.
Run scripts/ops/validate_lightning_upload.py before every model-store upload.
Run a storage inventory after every benchmark campaign and prune superseded artifacts.
